Create Function CDN.PROD_NumerDokumentuZwiazanego(@p_PZAID integer, @p_Typ_ProdZasoby integer) returns varchar(1000) as begin declare @wynik varchar(1000)
set @wynik = ''
select @wynik = @wynik + CDN.NumerDokumentu(TRN_GIDTyp, TRN_SPITyp, TRN_TRNTyp, TRN_TrnNumer, Trn_TRNRok, TRN_TrnSeria, TrN_TrnMiesiac) +', ' + (case (select count(*) from (select trs_GIDNUmer from cdn.traselem join cdn.traelem on tre_gidnumer = trs_gidnumer and tre_gidlp = trs_GIDlp where trs_ZlcTyp = @p_Typ_ProdZasoby and trs_zlcNumer = @p_PZAID group by Trs_GIDTyp, TRs_GIDNumer, TRs_GIDLp ) b ) when 1 then (Select top 1 ltrim(cast(tre_Pozycja as varchar(10))) from cdn.traselem join cdn.traelem on tre_gidnumer = trs_gidnumer and tre_gidlp = trs_GIDlp where trs_ZlcTyp = @p_Typ_ProdZasoby and trs_zlcNumer = @p_PZAID ) else '' end) +' ' + isnull(( select top 1 CDN.NumerDokumentuZ(Man_GIDTyp,0,MaN_TrNTyp,MaN_TrNNumer,Man_TrnRok,Man_TrnSeria,Man_TrnMiesiac,0,0,MaN_WMS) from CDN.MAgsElem join cdn.MAgnag on Mas_GIDNUmer = MAn_GIDNUmer where Mas_ZrdTyp = Trn_GidTyp and Mas_ZrdNumer = Trs_GidNumer group by MAN_GIDTyp, MAN_TRNTyp, MAN_TrnNumer, MAn_TRNRok, MAN_TrnSeria, MAN_TrnMiesiac,MaN_WMS ),'')+' | ' from CDN.TrasElem join cdn.Tranag on trs_GIDNUmer = trn_GIDNUmer where trs_ZlcTyp = @p_Typ_ProdZasoby and trs_zlcNumer = @p_PZAID group by TRN_GIDTyp, TRN_SPITyp, TRN_TRNTyp, TRN_TrnNumer, Trn_TRNRok, TRN_TrnSeria, TrN_TrnMiesiac, Trs_GidNumer
select @wynik = @wynik + CDN.NumerDokumentuZ(Man_GIDTyp,0,MaN_TrNTyp,MaN_TrNNumer,Man_TrnRok,Man_TrnSeria,Man_TrnMiesiac,0,0,MaN_WMS) +', ' + (case (select count(*) from (select mas_GIDNUmer from cdn.Magselem join cdn.Magelem on Mae_gidnumer = Mas_gidnumer and Mae_gidlp = Mas_GIDlp where mas_ZlcTyp = @p_Typ_ProdZasoby and mas_zlcNumer = @p_PZAID group by Mas_GIDTyp, Mas_GIDNumer, Mas_GIDLp ) b ) when 1 then (Select top 1 ltrim(cast(Mae_Pozycja as varchar(10))) from cdn.Magselem join cdn.MAgelem on Mae_gidnumer = Mas_gidnumer and Mae_gidlp = Mas_GIDlp where MAs_ZlcTyp = @p_Typ_ProdZasoby and Mas_zlcNumer = @p_PZAID ) else '' end) from CDN.MAgsElem join cdn.MAgnag on Mas_GIDNUmer = MAn_GIDNUmer where Mas_ZlcTyp = @p_Typ_ProdZasoby and Mas_zlcNumer = @p_PZAID group by MAN_GIDTyp, MAN_TRNTyp, MAN_TrnNumer, MAn_TRNRok, MAN_TrnSeria, MAN_TrnMiesiac,MaN_WMS
IF @p_Typ_ProdZasoby = 14346 BEGIN select @wynik = @wynik + PTC_Kod +'/'+ ISNULL(Twr_Kod,PTZ_Kod) +',' from CDN.ProdZasoby p1 left join CDN.ProdZasoby p2 on p1.PZA_ID = p2.PZA_Zasob left join cdn.prodzasoby p3 on P3.PZA_Id IN (SELECT PZP_PZAIDPlanowany FROM CDN.ProdZwiazanePolprodukty WHERE PZP_PZAIDWykonany = P1.PZA_Id) join CDN.ProdTechnologiaZasoby on coalesce(p2.PZA_TechnologiaZasob,p3.pza_technologiaZasob) = PTZ_ID LEFT JOIN CDN.TwrKarty ON COALESCE(P2.PZA_TwrNumer,P3.PZA_TwrNumer) = Twr_GIDNumer AND COALESCE(P2.PZA_TwrTyp,P3.PZA_TwrTyp) = 16 left join CDN.ProdCzynnosci on PCZ_ID = coalesce(p2.PZA_CZynnosc,p3.PZA_Czynnosc) join CDN.ProdTechnologiaCzynnosci on PTC_ID = PCZ_TechnologiaCzynnosc Where P1.PZA_id = @P_pzaid AND p1.PZA_TypZasobu = 0 -- produkt END
if len(@wynik)>995 set @wynik = substring(@wynik,1,995)+'...'
return @wynik end
